digest: Glow Party early-bird pricing runs through 9/26 — tickets include appetizers, wood-fired pizza, dessert, and live music. Families are still asked to turn in the free/reduced-meals form even though all meals are free this year; the data supports school funding. Glow Party volunteers are still needed for setup, the event, and cleanup on Friday.
